plain_english_definition: Of the opportunities that closed this quarter how many we won
numerator_definition: count of opportunities stage Closed Won close_date in period
denominator_definition: count of opportunities stage Closed Won or Closed Lost close_date in period
key_assumptions: Closed - No Decision is bucketed as Lost
known_limitations: biased by which deals happened to land in the period

plain_english_definition: Of the opportunities that closed this quarter where the customer decided how many we won
numerator_definition: count of opportunities stage Closed Won close_date in period
denominator_definition: count of opportunities stage Closed Won or Closed Lost or Closed - No Decision close_date in period
known_limitations: no-decision is blank on 31% of closed-lost records

plain_english_definition: Of the opportunities that closed this quarter how many we won excluding the one-off deal
numerator_definition: count of Closed Won minus 1 manually removed row
denominator_definition: count of Closed Won or Closed Lost

plain_english_definition: Revenue retained and expanded from customers we had a year ago
formula: (Start ARR - churn - downgrade + expansion) / Start ARR
numerator_definition: starting ARR less churn and downgrades plus expansion
denominator_definition: ARR of customers active at period start
key_assumptions: ARR-weighted point-to-point new logos excluded FX as reported
known_limitations: differs from chained monthly NRR when growth is non-linear

plain_english_definition: Orders attributed to the flow within the attribution window
numerator_definition: orders where conversion_metric_id matched within window
key_assumptions: conversion_metric_id is set per flow so two flows can mean two different events
known_limitations: changing the attribution window restates all history retroactively

plain_english_definition: Key events counted per the property counting method
numerator_definition: key events matching the configured definition
grain: event or session depending on counting method
key_assumptions: counting method once-per-event vs once-per-session changes the number
known_limitations: subject to thresholding and cardinality rollup; not reconcilable to the UI exactly

plain_english_definition: A person whose score crossed the qualification threshold
formula: CASE WHEN score >= 85 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
known_limitations: business logic in a staging model; history cannot be restated without a rebuild
